caption:
Global Metadata: Japanese whisper-vocal art pop / minimal new-wave indie pop. 124 BPM, F-sharp minor with brief modal-major flashes, 4/4. A 90-second non-looping game opening about the split between daytime company life and nighttime phone life, debt deadlines, choice, and exploitation. Urban digital surrealism: cute, cool, catchy, and faintly unsettling. Precise but human, with a short unresolved button ending and no fade.

Vocal Details: Close-miked airy Japanese adult female whisper-singing in a soft upper-mid register. Restrained deadpan timbre with audible but controlled breathiness, clear consonants, minimal vibrato, and slightly syncopated spoken-like verse phrasing. Choruses are gently double-tracked, never huge; small centered backing whispers of "Re Re Re" support key hooks. Keep the lead centered and forward in a dry intimate mix. No belting, idol squeal, rap, opera, or theatrical vocal runs.

Arrangement: [Intro] begins with a two-bar filtered synth notification motif, then muted clean-guitar 16ths and a small analog synth appear. [Verse 1] stays sparse: melodic dry bass, tight dry rim clicks and hi-hat, guitar, and rare glockenspiel replies. [Pre-Chorus] adds restrained rising synth pressure and a little more hat movement. [Chorus] opens into a catchy but controlled full groove with gently doubled vocal, dry drums, bass, guitar, analog synth, and sparse glockenspiel; no EDM drop. [Verse 2] returns to the close, sparse texture with altered guitar and bass responses. [Bridge] switches to half-time minimal drums, filtered notification motif, and isolated breathy whispers. [Final Chorus] returns the full restrained hook with a small lift, then [Outro] strips to notification synth, guitar harmonic, and an unresolved final button. Non-looping; end cleanly without a fade.
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Re Re Re)
午前零時　画面がひかる
知らない声が　わたしを知ってる

[Verse 1]
十日ぶんの呼吸を数え
五十万の朝を待つ
会社のわたしはコピー用紙
夜のわたしはパスワード
借りものの笑顔を貼って
名前のない期待を読む
誰かの正解なぞるたび
本音だけログアウト

[Pre-Chorus]
やさしさは　利息つき
本音には　既読がつかない
「選んで」って言われる前に
選ばれたのは　どっち？

[Chorus]
Re Re Re　繰り返して
わたしの値段を書き換える
白い昼と　青い夜
境界線をスワイプする
ねえ　奪われないためなら
どこまで奪っていいの？
通知音だけが　かわいく鳴った

[Verse 2]
エレベーターは上へ行くのに
残高だけは下へ行く
嘘をつくのは下手なくせに
黙ることだけ上手になる
ポケットのなかの予言者が
あなたの弱さを指でなぞる
助けるふりのアルゴリズム
わたしまで解析する

[Pre-Chorus]
同情には　期限つき
後悔には　名前がない
「信じて」って言われる前に
疑ったのは　どっち？

[Bridge]
(ねえ　Re Re Re)
正しさを　反転して
被害者と加害者の
あいだでカーソルが点滅
だれが　だれを　選ぶの

[Chorus]
Re Re Re　繰り返して
わたしの未来を書き換える
白い昼も　青い夜も
ひとつの嘘でつながってる
ねえ　奪われないためなら
どこまで奪っていいの？
通知音だけが　かわいく鳴った
(Re Re Re)

[Outro]
午前零時　画面が消える
知らないわたしが　こちらを見てる

vocal_validation.assessment: The non-empty Japanese lyric transcription and high-register pitch distribution are consistent with a sung upper-register female lead. This is signal-based verification, not a speaker-identity claim.
